description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'NoRecordsFoundController' within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract controller and overrides the preRender method to set a Vue component indicating 'no-records-found'. The file sets up a specific controller for handling scenarios where no records are found in a request context.

classes.name: NoRecordsFoundController
classes.description: A controller class that sets up a Vue component for 'no records found' scenarios, inheriting from an abstract Vue controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides the preRender method to initialize a Vue component called 'no-records-found' before rendering.
